title: ntfy (send notifications)
description: Sends a message as a push notification through ntfy (ntfy.sh or your own server) to every phone subscribed to a topic: a message.send connector. Text only; ntfy (send files) sends a file.
setup_notes: Install the ntfy app on your phone and subscribe to a topic. Anyone who knows a topic's name on ntfy.sh can read it, so pick one nobody would guess. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which sends a short test notification. Nothing in gohort sends through a send-only connector yet. A server that requires sign-in needs an access token: declare a secret setting sent as bearer in its spec's config, name it in auth in place of none, and give the token under Settings on its row.
